name: Confrontation

variants.name: Open Battle
variants.description: Both sides are attempting to defeat the opposing force.

variants.name: Targeted Confrontation
variants.description: One side must defeat a designated Character, Monster, or Unit. The GM identifies the designated Target before deployment unless a Hidden Information Special Rule applies.

openBattleRules.trackingRule: Track the starting Points of each side's participating army, including Units assigned to Reserves.
openBattleRules.scoring: At the end of Round 5, calculate the percentage of the opposing starting army's Points lost by each side. A defeated single-model Unit contributes its entire purchased Points cost; an un-Defeated single-model Unit contributes no defeated Points from its accumulated Damage. For a multi-model Unit, use its purchased total Points multiplied by (number of Models defeated at the end of battle ÷ starting Model count). This includes paid weapons and upgrades proportionally and also applies to Double Formations. Un-Defeated remaining Models with partial Wounds do not contribute fractional Model losses. Track actual surviving Models after any legally resolved reinforcement; Units still in Reserve count in the starting army but not as defeated merely because they did not enter.
openBattleRules.victory: The side that defeated the greater percentage wins. A side also wins immediately if every opposing combat Unit has been Defeated and the opponent has no eligible forces remaining. If the percentages are equal, the encounter is a Draw.
openBattleRules.casualtyNote: For casualty-based victory, a Downed Character counts as defeated, but uses the normal Critical Injury and recovery rules afterward.

targetedConfrontationRules.attackingSideVictory: The attacking side wins when the designated Target is defeated.
targetedConfrontationRules.defendingSideVictory: The defending side wins if the Target survives until the end of Round 5.
targetedConfrontationRules.note: Defeating unrelated Units does not automatically complete the Primary.

campaignNotes: Confrontation may resolve military supremacy, a contested challenge, the removal of a significant threat, or an eligible Warfare Stake. Winning does not automatically grant territory or additional formations.
